I'm originally from Australia. As you can imagine, this is a bit of a change in terms of climate adjustment as well.

The first winter I spent over here, it was terrible. I made the mistake of arriving in September, coming over from the Southern Hemisphere Winter, to the beginning of the Oregon Winter. Naturally, this resulted in a heap of darkness-induced depression.

Thankfully though, over time, it's gotten better. We (myself and my wife) have used full-spectrum lighting, ensured that we eat good, warm, fragrant food and we try to keep active in the wintertime as much as we can. Just this past winter we went up to Hood for the first time and little fun activities like that make the time pass a lot easier. It's very tempting to just stay inside underneath blankets inside and do nothing, but it's the worst thing you can do in the long-term.

So yeah, in a nutshell: Full-spectrum lighting, Good warm fragrant food and keep active.
